_comment: Indoor maps where ordinary monster groups can spawn and respawn.
Use map IDs because a subarea can contain both combat and peaceful rooms.
MapMobs is generated from subarea rosters, so a seeded group alone is not evidence.
Dungeon rooms use their own rules. This list only overrides the indoor filter.

zones.name: Incarnam Mine
zones.why: All seven mine rooms in subarea 778. Aminitas drop the powder for A Bit of Pigment.

zones.name: Astrub Sewers
zones.why: The eight explorable sewer maps in subarea 100, whose client roster contains Astrub rats and sewer arachnees.

zones.name: Labyrinth of the Minotoror
zones.why: The 24 monster rooms in subarea 319. Room 13 contains the entrance to the boss and has no groups.
